newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Dec first 20 days trade surplus falls 33.2%.
newsitem.headline: Japan Dec first 20 days trade surplus falls 33.2%.

text.p: Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus fell 33.2 percent to 205.84 billion yen in the first 20 days of December, compared with a revised surplus of 308.06 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry announced on Monday.
Free-on-board (FOB) exports rose 13.0 percent to 2.72 trillion yen from a year earlier, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 19.8 percent to 2.52 trillion yen.
